title: 第192章 淇幻认主入怀逆转时空破局第191章 淇幻墓前献神魂熙露煦露双入怀
content_zh:
要么投怀送抱。
要么兵戎相见。
话多，只能说明她底气不足。
我懒得跟她绕弯子，抬手便按向第三道墓门。
哈哈！
门开了！
就在这时，眼前白光骤闪，“仓颉玉筒”
自动撑开了规则护罩。
一道炽白光束凭空劈落，正撞在护罩上，被消解成一片柔和的光晕，四下漫开。
是激光——足以撕裂时空的超高能激光！
我没料到“仓颉玉筒”
连跨维度袭来的激光都能挡下。
想来是这激光能级太高，已经触及时空稳定的边界，才触发了“仓颉玉筒”
的规则守护机制。
光束消散后，墓室里缓缓亮起柔和的白光，看不到光源在哪，却把每一处角落都照得透亮。
看来，她认栽了。
这墓穴里的宝贝，全归我了。
据我所知，就算是九级文明，也没法构建出带完整灵体本源的维度空间来长久存放灵物。
所以墓里的灵物，大概率不会藏在别的维度里，最多收在灵晶小世界或是储物戒指中。
我把散落各处的灵晶、储物戒指一股脑全收进了灵体小世界。

熙露、煦露、俪凤三人立刻动手，逐枚清点灵晶，挨个翻看戒指里的存货。
酆淇幻不愧是灵阵大宗师，攒下的材料浩如烟海，品类也杂得惊人。
等所有灵物分门别类清点完毕，我便一并转进了“灵识空间”
这样一来，就算我这道分身真折在这里，本体或是其他分身迟早能连通“灵识空间”
取走这些东西，也算没白闯这一趟。
可惜全是原材料，既没有成品灵阵、阵盘、灵器、灵符，也找不到半本功法秘籍。
脑海里半句废话都没有。
看来她已经彻底认栽了。
但事情还没完。
她的主棺还没搜过——虽说梦里探过，里头就只有1枚20级灵晶。
伸手推开棺盖，里头果然孤零零躺着1枚20级灵晶。
我拿起灵晶，神识往里一探，内里空空如也。
1枚20级灵晶也算一笔巨额财富，差不多抵得上一颗星球上千年的产出。
但对我而言，42天就能凝聚出1枚，实在没什么吸引力。
她的肉身肯定就在这附近。
不然她费尽心机收集我的“神之魂”
做什么？
在我看来，“神”
的魂魄，最大的用处就是轮回重生。
我把棺内摸了个遍，连缝隙里的微尘都没放过，没找出半点异样。
content_en:
Or throw yourself into your arms.
Or meet each other in war.
Talking too much only shows that she lacks confidence.
I was too lazy to follow her around the bush, so I raised my hand and pressed on the third tomb door.
Ha ha!
The door is open!
At this moment, a white light suddenly flashed in front of his eyes, "Cangjie Jade Cylinder"
The rule shield was automatically opened.
A blazing white beam of light fell out of thin air, hit the shield, and was dissolved into a soft halo of light that spread in all directions.
It's a laser—an ultra-high-energy laser capable of tearing apart space and time!
I didn't expect "Cangjie Jade Tube"
It can even block lasers coming from across dimensions.
It seems that the energy level of this laser is too high and has touched the stable boundary of space and time, which is why the "Cangjie Jade Cylinder" was triggered.
rules guarding mechanism.
After the light beam dissipated, a soft white light slowly lit up in the tomb. The source of the light could not be seen, but it illuminated every corner.
It seemed that she had given up.
The treasures in this tomb are all mine.
As far as I know, even a ninth-level civilization cannot construct a dimensional space with complete spiritual origin to store spiritual objects for a long time.
Therefore, the spiritual objects in the tomb will most likely not be hidden in other dimensions. At most, they will be stored in the small world of spiritual crystals or storage rings.
I collected all the spiritual crystals and storage rings scattered everywhere into the small spiritual world.
Xi Lu, Xu Lu, and Lifeng immediately started counting the spiritual crystals one by one and looking through the inventory in the ring one by one.
Feng Qihuan is indeed the great master of the spiritual formation. He has accumulated a huge amount of materials and the categories are astonishingly diverse.
After all the spiritual objects were sorted and counted, I moved into the "Spiritual Consciousness Space"
In this way, even if my clone is really here, the main body or other clones will be able to connect to the "spiritual consciousness space" sooner or later.
After taking these things, this trip was not in vain.
Unfortunately, they are all raw materials. There are no finished spiritual arrays, array disks, spiritual weapons, or spiritual talismans, and I can't find even half a secret book of techniques.
There is not a single nonsense sentence in my mind.
It seems that she has completely accepted her defeat.
But it's not over yet.
Her main coffin has not been searched yet - although it was searched in her dream, there was only one level 20 spiritual crystal in it.
He reached out and pushed open the coffin lid, and there was indeed a level 20 spiritual crystal lying alone inside.
I picked up the spiritual crystal and looked inside with my spiritual consciousness. It was empty inside.
A level 20 spiritual crystal can be considered a huge fortune, almost equivalent to the output of a planet for a thousand years.
But for me, it takes 42 days to condense one piece, which is really not attractive.
Her physical body must be nearby.
Otherwise, she would go to great lengths to collect my "god soul"
What to do?
In my opinion, "God"
The greatest use of the soul is reincarnation.
I searched all over the coffin, not even missing the dust in the cracks, and couldn't find anything out of the ordinary.
